activity.notes: Ordelafo Faliero is conventionally placed as Doge of Venice from about 1102 until his death in battle near Zara in 1117 or, at the latest, 1118. The detailed Treccani biography stresses that early-12th-century dogal chronology is not secure, so ATLAS preserves the familiar c.1102-c.1118 interval with both boundaries approximate rather than presenting an exact accession or death year.

sources.title: Falièro, Ordelafo — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani identifies Ordelafo Faliero as Doge of Venice from 1102 and records his death fighting near Zara.

sources.title: FALIER, Ordelaffo — Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani
sources.citation_text: The detailed biographical entry explains the uncertainty of the early-twelfth-century dogal chronology and places Faliero's death in 1117 or at the latest 1118.
